[d0749] config | acktracker.max_retries | version 4.x
# `acktracker.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `20` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | acktracker |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `acktracker.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
max_retries = 20
```

[d0735] config | acktracker.timeout_ms | version 4.x
# `acktracker.timeout_ms`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Time in milliseconds that the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed waits for a response before the operation fails.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | ms |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `acktracker.timeout_ms` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
timeout_ms = 5000
```

---

[d0507] changelog | PaderQueue 1.1 release notes | version 1.1
.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

- New option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

- New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `partitioner.enabled`: turns the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written on or off.

---

[d0208] config | acktracker.interval_s | version 4.x
# `acktracker.interval_s`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `30` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | s |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
interval_s = 30
```

---

# `partitioner.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | partitioner |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `partitioner.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
max_retries = 10
```

`acktracker.timeout_ms` controls how long the acknowledgement tracker waits for a response before the operation fails. Its default is `5000` ms.
